title: Engineer Invoice
description: Structured completion artifact returned by the Engineer (Ruflo) to the Architect after a job finishes. The Architect uses this to close the issue, record cost, and calibrate future job selection.

invoice_id.description: Unique identifier for this invoice (e.g. uuid4 or issue-<n>-<timestamp>).

issue.description: GitHub issue number the job was executed against.

status.description: completed — PR opened and CI green; failed — unrecoverable error; partial — work done but CI or tests still red; needs-human — Engineer hit an ambiguity it cannot resolve.

branch.description: Git branch the Engineer pushed work to (e.g. pipeline/issue-101). Null if no commit was made.

pr_number.description: Pull request number opened by the Engineer. Null if no PR was created.

scope_actual.description: Actual complexity the Engineer observed. Compared against the Architect's classified scope to calibrate future routing.

route_used.description: Model tier the Engineer consumed. Lets the Architect track cost vs scope.

artifacts.description: Paths or URLs of produced artifacts (files changed, PR URL, test report).

errors.description: Error messages if status is failed or partial.

summary.description: One-paragraph human-readable account of what was done (or why it failed). Posted by the Architect as a PR/issue comment.
